chunk_text: Should Saturn, the Sun and Mars be in the 12th, 9th and 8th without benefic's aspect, the child will face instant death.
With a malefic in the 7th house or in the rising decanate while decreasing Moon is in the ascendant, death will be experienced early.
The life span of the child will be either 2 months or 6 months only, if all planets devoid of strength are relegated to Apoklima houses (i.e. 3rd, 6th, 9th and 12th:)
The mother Of the native will incur evils (will die soon) if the Moon at birth is aspected by three malefics.

If the Moon is in the 7th/8th from a malefic, be herself with a malefic, and be aspected by a strong malefic, predict mother's end to be early.

Should a malefic be in the 4th, identical with an inimical sign, counted from the Moon while there is no benefic in an angle, the child will lose its mother in a premature manner.

chunk_text: Malefics in the 6th and 12th will bring evils to mother.
The child's father will receive similar effects if the 4th and 10th are captured by malefics.
Mercury in the 2nd while malefics occupy the ascendant, 7th and 12th : this yoga will destroy the entire family.
Jupiter, Saturn and Rahu respectively posited in the ascendant, 2nd and 3rd will cause mother's death early.
Doubtlessly the mother will give up the child if it has malefics in trines counted from the decreasing Moon. No benefic shall be in conjunction with the said malefics.

The native will at the time of his marriage lose his father if Jupiter is in the ascendant while Saturn, Sun, Mars and Mercury are together in the 2nd.
Early loss of father will take place if the Sun is with a malefic or is hemmed between malefics as there is another malefic in the 7th from the Sun.

chunk_text: Remote will be the possibility of one's father surviving if the Sun is in the 7th while Mars is in the 10th and Rahu is in the 12th.
Early and doubtless will be one's father's death if Mars is in the 10th identical with his enemy's sign.
The Moon in the 6th, Saturn in the ascendant and Mars in the 7th : this array of heavenly bodies at birth will not ensure a long span of life for the father.
If the Sun is aspected by Saturn and be in Aries/Scorpio Navamsa, the father would have given up the family before the birth of the child or would have passed away.
If the 4th, 10th and 12th are all occupied by malefics, both the parents will leave the child to its own fate and wander from place to place.

chunk_text: The father will not see the native till his (the native's) 23rd year if Rahu and Jupiter are together in an inimical sign identical with the ascendant or the 4th.
The Sun is the indicator of father for all beings while the mother is indicated by the Moon.
Should the sun be aspected by malefics or be hemmed between them will cause evils to father.
